patterns.name: Bulk Historical Load
patterns.flow: On-prem/External S3 -> Storage Transfer Service (STS) -> GCS -> BigQuery Load
patterns.use_case: Data warehouse migration, initial system sync
patterns.cost_logic: Lowest cost per GB, utilizes GCS Nearline/Coldline.

patterns.name: Scheduled Micro-batch
patterns.flow: Cloud Scheduler -> Cloud Functions/Workflows -> API/DB -> GCS
patterns.use_case: Nightly sales reports, daily inventory sync
patterns.impact: Requires consideration for resource contention during peak hours.

patterns.name: ETL/ELT Pipeline
patterns.use_case: Complex transformations, cross-database joins, data quality checks
patterns.strategy: Load raw to GCS, transform in BigQuery (ELT) or Dataflow (ETL).
